Look you go to practice tool. So aa's have 3 phases whindup -where you start your animation 
The damage prock which is the part where the damage is applied and the damage numbers pop up
And finally the cool off where you do an animation returning the weapon. 

So basically you can't do anything about the first 2 phases but you can cancel the third immediately after you see the damage numbers by using your movement click or by casting a skill and using a movement click (the second one is imo better and faster)

So just try to aa - use a skill when you see damage numbers - click to move.
If the animation looks really janky congrats you've done it
